title.zh: 手机播放条常驻，曲库改用 256px 缩略图（更省解码、不再突然弹出）
title.en: A permanent phone player bar, and 256px cover thumbnails for the library

highlights.zh: 手机首页的播放条不再「点了才出现」：它常驻在原来的位置，并以默认曲风（Chicago House）预填名称、BPM、封面和播放键，停止播放后仍保留你最后听的那首。
highlights.en: The phone player bar no longer appears only once something plays: it is permanent, seeded with the default genre (name, BPM, cover, play control), and keeps naming the last genre after the transport stops.

highlights.zh: 曲库封面改为 256×256 缩略图并异步解码：原来每张磁贴都在解码 1024×1024（单张 130KB–626KB）只为画 56px，实测 comic/deep-house 从 626570 字节降到 16729 字节。
highlights.en: Cover art is now a 256x256 thumbnail decoded asynchronously: tiles used to decode 1024x1024 (130-626 KB each) to draw 56px, measured at 626570 to 16729 bytes for comic/deep-house.

highlights.zh: 兜底链保留两个维度：皮肤缩略图 → 共享缩略图 → 皮肤原图 → 共享原图；黑胶标签仍用原图（它烘焙在 512px）。
highlights.en: The fallback keeps both dimensions: skin thumb, shared thumb, skin original, shared original; the vinyl label still uses the original, because it bakes at 512px.
